title: Are Video Generation Models Geographically Fair? An Attraction-Centric Evaluation of Global Visual Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the structural and visual alignment of AI-generated videos of tourist attractions across different continents and countries by comparing them to real-world reference images using Patch-Level CLIP, Keypoint-Based Local Alignment, and VLM-as-a-Judge.
Grouping and comparing the visual fidelity of generated attractions between the Global North and Global South to reflect disparities related to economic development and regional data availability.
Analyzing the performance of video generation models on landmarks categorized into the Global West versus the Global East to capture disparities across broad cultural groupings.

Correlating the structural alignment and visual fidelity scores of generated landmarks with their Wikipedia page view statistics to assess if models favor more prominent or frequently documented attractions.
